page_title: Contact the Department of Canadian Heritage
author: system
content:
Contact the Department of Canadian Heritage

Your questions and comments are important to us. We are committed to providing you with accurate information in a timely manner.

If you would like to provide feedback on accessibility, view this accessibility feedback page.

On this page

  • General enquiries
  • Requests for ministerial messages

General enquiries

Address
15 Eddy Street
Gatineau, QC J8X 4B3
Email
info@pch.gc.ca
Telephone
1-866-811-0055
Call toll-free from all regions, Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. (Eastern time)
Video Relay Service (VRS)
You can use free VRS services ( ASL and LSQ ) to provide us your feedback or questions (for people who are deaf, hard of hearing or speech impaired).
TTY
1-888-997-3123 (for people who are deaf, hard of hearing or speech impaired)

Requests for ministerial messages

A ministerial message is an official message from the Minister or Secretary of State recognizing an event or achievement by an organization supported by Canadian Heritage.
